articles.title: Start-up unveils prototype ‘heart’ of EUV lithography amid China chipmaking push
articles.summary: A Chinese start-up has introduced a prototype extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light-source machine, a pivotal component in advanced lithography systems, signaling a significant advancement in China's quest for self-sufficiency in chipmaking technology. This breakthrough not only enhances China's technological capabilities but also poses a challenge to global semiconductor supply chains dominated by established players.

articles.title: The Nordics and NVIDIA Show What’s Possible When a Region Commits to Advanced Computing
articles.summary: The Nordic countries are emerging as a powerhouse in advanced computing, leading Europe in unicorn startup density and positioning themselves to create a transformative technology ecosystem that could redefine the continent's innovation landscape. This strategic commitment not only highlights the region's potential but also sets a precedent for how focused investment in technology can drive economic growth and attract global talent.

articles.title: US and China race to shape AI agenda ahead of Xi-Trump talks in Shenzhen, sources say
articles.summary: The United States and China are intensifying their collaboration on artificial intelligence governance, aiming to establish a framework for managing AI-related incidents ahead of crucial talks between Xi Jinping and Donald Trump, highlighting the geopolitical significance of AI as a pivotal area of cooperation in global diplomacy. This breakthrough could set the stage for a new era of international standards and cooperation in AI technology, influencing global economic and security landscapes.

articles.title: ‘China shock 3.0’ to be driven by AI, biotech and robot exports, economist says
articles.summary: The impending "China shock 3.0," fueled by a surge in exports of AI, biotechnology, and robotics, is poised to significantly disrupt global markets, potentially surpassing the impact of previous economic waves. This transformation underscores China's escalating role as a technological powerhouse, reshaping industries and international trade dynamics.

articles.title: Bünyamin Aydın’s new collection, “From Earth to Sky,” soars with iPad Pro
articles.summary: Bünyamin Aydın's groundbreaking collection, "From Earth to Sky," merges Turkish heritage with rock influences and futurism, showcased in a stunning fashion show in Cappadocia, all captured with the advanced capabilities of the iPhone 18 Pro Max, highlighting the intersection of technology and artistry in modern fashion. This innovative approach not only elevates the fashion narrative but also demonstrates the transformative power of mobile technology in creative industries.

articles.title: ASML’s chip equipment sales to China soar 109% despite US export curb push
articles.summary: ASML's chip equipment sales to China skyrocketed by 109% in the third quarter, defying US export restrictions and positioning China to represent 20% of ASML's total sales this year, highlighting the resilience and growing demand in the semiconductor market despite geopolitical tensions. This breakthrough underscores the shifting dynamics in global technology supply chains and the potential for China to bolster its semiconductor capabilities.

articles.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
articles.summary: Amp is revolutionizing the capabilities of AI agents by integrating OpenAI's advanced models, including GPT-6 Astra and Ultrafast, enabling them to perform complex tasks beyond mere coding. This breakthrough not only expands the functional scope of AI agents but also enhances their utility across various industries, signaling a significant leap in AI technology.

articles.title: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
articles.summary: SentinelOne's integration of OpenAI Daybreak revolutionizes cybersecurity by reducing malware analysis time from weeks to mere hours, significantly enhancing the capacity to identify and respond to threats more efficiently. This breakthrough not only accelerates threat detection but also empowers organizations to stay ahead in an increasingly complex digital landscape.

articles.title: China approves Alibaba AI models for use in iPhone Duo and other Apple handsets
articles.summary: China's approval of Alibaba's AI models for integration into Apple handsets, including the iPhone Duo, marks a significant breakthrough in the tech landscape, enabling the long-awaited launch of Apple Intelligence in the Chinese market and enhancing the competitive edge of both companies amidst growing demand for advanced AI capabilities.

articles.title: Into the fire
articles.summary:
• The resilience of women who escaped ISIS illustrates the profound strength found in vulnerability and survival.  
• By defusing landmines, these women reclaim their homeland, transforming symbols of destruction into agents of healing.  
• Their work embodies a powerful act of resistance, challenging the narratives imposed by violence and oppression.  
• The act of rebuilding a community from the ashes of trauma highlights the intricate relationship between suffering and empowerment.  
• In confronting the remnants of war, these women redefine their identities and assert their rightful place in a fractured society.
